candidate_verification_scope: Controller check of available public evidence only; these bytes are not supplied to native buyers. Public-key consistency does not independently establish issuer identity.
awake_policy: caffeinate -i around each native invocation; serial native sessions; sampled vitest/workerd load log; no heavy local tests intentionally launched during acquisition. Samples cannot establish the absence of all host load.
native_attempt_policy: Fresh qualification once per buyer host and offline recipient. At most four planned buyers and one recipient per eligible completed buyer; no retries, budget or freshness expansion.
